summary: Revise contract: Revise this existing feature to include the user's requested easier Kernel-style login: a user-clicked Open in your browser handoff on Cerq Browser surfaces opens the same validated project viewer in a new client browser tab (their Mac), while the agent continues using the same project-bound Steel session. Kernel BB app.tsx uses target=_blank links for live views and hosted login; do not switch engines or copy local OS cookies. Update inline-only documentation/instructions so this explicit user action is supported. Preserve the original right-side icon panel, two-second non-modal hover expansion, BB native styling, Cerq Browser name and session isolation. Verify same-session URL, safe rel attributes, no automatic popups, independent control before viewer readiness/auth, user-activated popup in browser fixture, existing panel/human controls and local install/reload.

state.request: Improve the existing Steel Browser plugin: put the live agent browser viewer on the right side opened/closed by clicking a browser icon; dwelling the pointer over the browser panel for about two seconds expands it toward nearly full screen without a blocking modal, with a reversible return to compact view; mimic BB native UI styling, and replace Steel Browser user-facing branding with a personalized name (user preference pending; use configurable display name if needed). Preserve same project-bound browser session and ability to watch the agent work. Implement and verify the human UI and CLI.
